text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Messed up again. Things just aren't 
clicking into place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My plan and preparations to reel in the 
big fish weren't quite up to par either...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry for failing to live up 
to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I will take this result to heart and make 
the most of it on the next occasion!
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing our best together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As if—that could ever happen! Nyahaha, did 
I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you can't hold your ground here, 
there's no way you'll ever get 1st place, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The preparations that fell short this 
time— I promise to make them absolutely 
perfect next time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, please look forward to 
Sei-chan's next big performance!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Are you still placing your hopes on 
me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To an entirely ordinary Sei-chan like me, 
who has nothing going for her other than 
scheming...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I can't deliver after everything you've 
done for me, I'd be a disgrace to all 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's not like I have any 
intention of giving up or running away 
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"So, wanna go fishing together again 
sometime? —Aiming for the big one, of 
course!"
